governing_rule.primary: Continue the already established prophetic-narrative lineage sequence after the four completed production batches.
governing_rule.secondary: A subject is selectable only if not already processed as an independent batch and if its narrative zone can be scoped without silently absorbing a completed batch.
governing_rule.tie_break: Prefer the next direct lineage-linked prophetic subject whose corpus can be independently bounded; unresolved overlaps are handled later by PNIE and Interface Resolution.
governing_rule.immutability: Queue order may change only by explicit governance revision, never during an active batch.
